protocol_name: PET data augmentation protocol for pathology cell counting

input_annotation_format.note: All geometric augmentations update point coordinates synchronously with the image.

train_time_augmentations.name: random_scale
train_time_augmentations.condition: Only applied when scale * min(image_height, image_width) > patch_size.

if_condition_is_false.reason: Avoid making the shorter side smaller than patch_size before cropping.

train_time_augmentations.name: random_crop_or_resize_to_patch
train_time_augmentations.start_h_sampling: random.randint(0, image_height - patch_size) if image_height > patch_size else 0
train_time_augmentations.start_w_sampling: random.randint(0, image_width - patch_size) if image_width > patch_size else 0

point_filter.keep_condition: start_h <= y <= end_h and start_w <= x <= end_w
point_filter.discarded_points: points outside the crop are removed from the target

point_coordinate_update.after_crop: y = y - start_h; x = x - start_w
point_coordinate_update.after_resize: y = y * (patch_size / cropped_height); x = x * (patch_size / cropped_width)

train_time_augmentations.note: If the image is already 256x256, this operation usually keeps the full image. If one side is smaller than patch_size, the cropped image is resized to patch_size and points are scaled accordingly.

train_time_augmentations.name: random_horizontal_flip
train_time_augmentations.sampling_code: if random.random() > 0.5 and train and flip
train_time_augmentations.note: The implementation uses patch_size - x, exactly following the current code. It does not subtract 1.

train_empty_sample_filter.behavior_when_keep_empty_train_0: Training samples with zero GT points are filtered out before training.
train_empty_sample_filter.behavior_when_keep_empty_train_1: Training samples with zero GT points are kept.
train_empty_sample_filter.note: This is sample filtering, not an image augmentation.

validation_empty_sample_filter.behavior: Validation samples are kept even if they contain zero GT points.

reproducibility.note: Random scale, random crop and random horizontal flip use Python random.

summary_for_report: PET uses a lightweight point-level augmentation pipeline: ImageNet normalization for all splits; during training only, random scaling in [0.8, 1.2], random 256x256 cropping with synchronized point-coordinate update, and 50% horizontal flip. No rotation, vertical flip, affine translation/shear, color jitter, blur or noise augmentation is used.
